entities.name: Quintin Hogg, Baron Hailsham of St Marylebone
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Quintin McGarel Hogg, Baron Hailsham of Saint Marylebone, was a British barrister and Conservative Party politician. He was known as the 2nd Viscount Hailsham between 1950 and 1963, at which point he disclaimed his hereditary peerage.
